title: Mee Awarded First Place
paragraphs: Doris Mee awarded first place in Mixed Media

Doris Mee was awarded first place in Mixed Media for her painting “Still Life in Purple & Green” at the Cape Cod Art Association member show on August 17, 2017. The theme of the show is “A Touch of Color”. The exhibit will be on display in both galleries through September 10, 2017 at Cape Cod Art Association, 3480 Route 6A (Main St.), Barnstable.
©Doris Mee, Still Life in Purple & Green

Meet Doris on Saturday, August 26 at The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, where is will create a still life, using her unique mixed media/collage method for creating this type of painting. She uses a wide variety of papers, which she hand paints in watercolor or acrylic in preparation for assembling her collage. Several new paintings will be displayed.

pwsbuilder August 20, 2017

Doris Mee was awarded first place in Mixed Media for her painting “Still Life in Purple & Green” at the Cape Cod Art Association member show on August 17, 2017.  The theme of the show is “A Touch of Color”. The exhibit will be on display in both galleries through September 10, 2017 at Cape Cod Art Association, 3480 Route 6A (Main St.), Barnstable.

Meet Doris on Saturday, August 26 at The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, where is will create a still life, using her unique mixed media/collage method for creating this type of painting. She uses a wide variety of papers, which she hand paints in watercolor or acrylic in preparation for assembling her collage. Several new paintings will be displayed.
